definitions.explanation: A moderate, balanced stance that avoids extremes. Used in politics to describe centrist positions, and in Buddhism to refer to the Middle Way — the path between indulgence and asceticism.

examples.japanese: {中道|ちゅうどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中道|ちゅうどう}⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掲|かか}げている→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧。
examples.english: That political party advocates a centrist line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{極端|きょくたん}→極端：13161_kyokutan⟧な⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}け→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧、{中道|ちゅうどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|あゆ}む→歩む：13196_ayumu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{考|かんが}えている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: I believe it is important to avoid extreme opinions on either side and walk the middle path.

notes:
Compound noun: ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (middle) + {道|どう} (way, path). Used in both political and Buddhist contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中道|ちゅうどう}⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧ (centrist line/policy)
- {中道|ちゅうどう}⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧ (centrist party)
- {中道|ちゅうどう}{右派|うは}/{左派|さは} (center-right/center-left)
- {中道|ちゅうどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|あゆ}む→歩む：13196_ayumu⟧ (to walk the middle path)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Buddhism, {中道|ちゅうどう} refers to the Middle Way taught by the Buddha — avoiding both extreme self-indulgence and extreme asceticism.
